ai-cgo 1.0.1 Changelog

- Added dynamic router logic, supporting classification and routing of user input to Diagnoser, Designer, or Optimizer modes.
- Introduced [learnings/router-signals.md] for extensible, user-updatable signal routing.
- Enhanced session/context memory: now tracks mode usage, past outputs, assumption log, user satisfaction, and more.
- Implemented detailed self-validation and execution metrics protocol for every output.
- Added explicit exclusion rules and pre-router input validation, improving routing accuracy and output relevance.
- Removed skill-card.md; reference and knowledge material now organized under learnings/.
